latest_release.name: v1.4.14
latest_release.body:
## New features
- OSC 1717 diff-line metadata support for Lazygit —  #538:
- `fileNameRulerShape` option — #545, closes #522:
- box (default) vs ruler shape for file names in git show mode.
- Terminal now reads from env `$COLUMNS` before falling back to `tput` — #556:
- `--date` iso support — 27e0ce5 + test for #540:
- Adds a simple `Makefile`

## Fixes
- Fix crash on git dates without timezone offset (log.date=local) — #544.
- Fix binary file parser when filename contains  and  — #547.
- Fix filename parsing when path contains b/ segment — #549.
- Fix crash on diff ending on truncated old mode line — #551.
- Fix strip_leading_indicators double-coloring raw diffs — #542.
- Harden Date: handling to skip when unixtime unparseable.

## Docs
- Update LazyGit link to `Custom_DiffRenderers.md`.
- `package.json` repo URL
- Bump actions/setup-node 4 -> 7 — #541.
